patterns.note: Rhythmic vertical scroll progression with consistent viewport-snapped layouts that create a hypnotic, meditative user journey.
Extreme negative space utilization, pushing branding to the top-left margin and interactive prompts to the lower-center, leaving the canvas completely open.
Unbroken, high-saturation peach/salmon color blocking that dominates the entire visual field to establish instant brand recall.

technique_notes: Recreate the hypnotic scroll experience by utilizing CSS Scroll Snapping (scroll-snap-type: y mandatory) on a full-height container, ensuring each section is exactly 100vh. Use GSAP ScrollTrigger to orchestrate subtle, staggered opacity fades on the minimal text elements as they enter and exit the viewport, maintaining a seamless, distraction-free flow.

design_tokens.type_scale: Strictly uniform, low-contrast type scale with small, clean sans-serif labels to emphasize negative space.

standout: The design stands out through its radical commitment to emptiness and repetition. By stripping away all traditional landing page components in favor of a singular, repeating scroll prompt on a solid color block, it transforms a simple website into a conceptual, meditative brand experience.
